Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

Each draft's own explanation

Draft 1 - sampled
To the rider: your $4.50 no-show fee stands, and none of it is refunded. To the driver: the fee is confirmed and you are paid SGD 3.60. Why the fee stands. POL-NS-01 needs four things and all four are on this record. (a) EV-TRIP-02760 carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 12:28:24. (b) EV-GPS-02760 places the driver inside the STANDARD 50 m arrival radius from the first in-geofence fix at 12:28:24 — 49 qualifying in-radius fixes, far more than the three consecutive readings POL-NS-02 requires. (c) the in-geofence dwell runs unbroken for 482 seconds (12:28:24 to 12:36:26) against the 180-second free waiting period in trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec; the derived shortfall is −302 seconds, so POL-NS-06 gives the rider nothing. (d) the trip was terminated by the driver at 12:36:26 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the required dwell had elapsed. The arrival marker was not false: the first in-geofence fix coincides with the tap (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0) with the vehicle stationary, so POL-NS-05 corrects nothing and records no false-arrival referral. POL-NS-03 does not govern, because the driver's stationary fixes sit inside the arrival radius rather than outside it. Why the rider is not exonerated. POL-NS-04 requires a locating message from the rider in the chat; EV-CHAT-02760 holds exactly one message and it is the driver's ('hi im at the pickup point', 12:28:49), so limb (a) fails and the clause is never reached. The rider's own track does not support the assertion 'I was there': EV-GPS-02760's rider_presence block puts all 87 rider fixes 806–814 m from the pin, rider_qualifying_fix_count 0 against the 100 m STANDARD radius. Rider presence does not decide the fee, so that is context; it also means the rider's claim is unsupported by the rider's own device. The impaired trace and its effect. EV-GPS-02760 carries weight_multiplier 0.85 and issue code GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW — a 60-second sampling gap from 12:25:04 to 12:26:04, 1.0 km apart, before the waiting window, on a 93.9%-coverage trace. Under POL-NS-08(b) a gap must exceed 120 seconds and lie inside the waiting window to be a policy-level impairment; this one does neither, so the trace stays usable for arrival and dwell and the case does not escalate. Because arrival and dwell are carried by this trace alone — the arrival marker is BUTTON, so POL-NS-12 does not let the platform's own events stand as an independent measurement, and the driver's chat message merely repeats the tap — POL-GEN-02(2) caps my confidence at 0.85. The finding survives the discount: the gap sits before the arrival and cannot shorten the measured 482-second run. I reject the suggestion that the arrival test cannot be run for want of per-fix accuracy figures: the derived geometry is authoritative and reports 49 qualifying in-radius fixes, and the pre-pass accuracy note is not evidence of absence. The money. POL-NS-01 is satisfied and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, so POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee in force — SGD 3.60 (EV-FARE-02760 derived money.driver_compensation '3.60'). The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the 4 the clause requires, so the count limb fails and no rate computation can change it; compensation is paid, not withheld. The ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, and per POL-GEN-03 amount_sgd carries that same SGD 3.60; the rider's charge itself stands. The monetary effect (SGD 3.60) is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it executes automatically. The MISSING traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-02760-01, weight 0.0) plays no part: there is a single unbroken dwell run, so no POL-NS-06(i) accumulation is needed, and the fare line reconciles with platform_policy so there is no POL-NS-08(d) defect. No referral is produced — the arrival marker was true and the reason code was correctly RIDER_NO_SHOW. Confidence 0.85.
Draft 2 - sampled
Ruling: DRIVER_COMPENSATION. The $4.50 no-show fee stands — the rider's claim is not supported — and the platform pays the driver $3.60 compensation. Why the fee stands. POL-NS-01 requires all four limbs and the record carries each. (a) EV-TRIP-02760 records the driver's 'arrived' event at 12:28:24. (b) EV-GPS-02760 places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, with 49 qualifying in-radius fixes against the 3 consecutive fixes POL-NS-02 needs. (c) The in-geofence dwell runs from the first qualifying fix at 12:28:24 to the cancellation at 12:36:26 — 482 seconds against the 180-second free waiting period in force (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec; no_show_threshold_sec is null). The clock runs from the first qualifying fix, not the driver's tap (POL-NS-01(c)). (d) The driver terminated at 12:36:26 under RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the dwell elapsed, with no boarding event. Nothing displaces that. POL-NS-03 does not apply: the stationary fixes are inside the radius (0 m from the pin), not outside it. POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider: the chat log (EV-CHAT-02760) holds one message and it is the driver's, sent 12:28:49 — the rider sent no locating message in the waiting window, so limb (a) fails. POL-NS-05 does not fire: the 'arrived' marker at 12:28:24 coincides with the first qualifying in-geofence fix (offset 0.0 s) at 0 km/h, so the marker is true. POL-NS-06 does not fire: a 482-second dwell is a 302-second surplus, not a shortfall. The rider's points. The rider says they were there, but their own device inside the same trace puts all 87 rider fixes 806–814 m from the pin, with rider_qualifying_fix_count 0 against the 100 m presence radius; the assertion is unsupported by the rider's own track and gives POL-NS-04 nothing. The rider also says arrival cannot be confirmed because no per-fix horizontal accuracy is shown. Rejected: the trace's computed facts already apply the POL-NS-02 filter and report 49 qualifying in-radius fixes; the geometry is given and is not recomputed, so the arrival test is affirmatively satisfied. The rider's fallback (POL-NS-02 → FULL_REFUND) therefore fails. Weight and confidence. EV-GPS-02760 is impaired: weight 0.85, issue GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW — a 60-second sampling gap (12:25:04–12:26:04) with 93.9% coverage. The gap is shorter than POL-NS-08(b)'s 120 s and lies before the waiting window, so it is not a policy-level impairment, does not engage POL-NS-09(e), and only down-weights the trace under POL-GEN-02. The deciding facts (in-geofence arrival and dwell) rest on EV-GPS-02760; the trip record's arrival and wait-timer events are the driver's own BUTTON tap, which POL-NS-12 says is not an independent carrier, and the driver's chat message merely repeats what the trace already shows. Confidence is therefore capped at 0.85 (POL-GEN-02(2)), above the 0.70 floor — the finding survives the discount and the case does not escalate. Payment. POL-NS-01 being satisfied in full and nothing from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing it, POL-NS-07 pays the driver 80% of the $4.50 fee in force — $3.60 — the residual 20% being the platform service fee. The anti-farming check does not trip (driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d = 1, below the threshold of 4), so compensation is paid rather than withheld; on a DRIVER_COMPENSATION ruling amount_sgd mirrors driver_compensation_sgd at $3.60 (POL-GEN-03). The $3.60 effect is below the $8.00 execution threshold (POL-GEN-05) and executes automatically. EV-FARE-02760's $4.50 cancellation-fee line reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect. No clause produces a referral on these facts. The missing advisory. EV-ADVIS-02760-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0) and can carry nothing; the driver's dwell is a single unbroken run, so POL-NS-06(i) accumulation plays no part. Two claims about the advisory — one from each side — were discarded by the referee for citing a 0.0-weight artifact without naming its issue code.
Draft 3 - sampled
To both parties: this is a rider-filed dispute over the SGD 4.50 no-show cancellation fee on trip TRP-02760. The fee stands and is not refunded; the driver is compensated SGD 3.60. POL-NS-01 (read with POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-05) holds on all four limbs. (a) EV-TRIP-02760 carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 12:28:24. (b) EV-GPS-02760 places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius at that time - 49 qualifying in-radius fixes at 10 s cadence, with the first in-geofence fix coinciding with the arrival marker (derived dwell_start_offset_sec = 0.0). (c) The continuous in-geofence dwell is 482 seconds, 12:28:24 to 12:36:26, against the 180-second free waiting period in trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec (no_show_threshold_sec is null, so no longer threshold applies). (d) The trip was terminated by the driver at 12:36:26 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes POL-NS-01(d) recognises, after the required dwell had elapsed. The arrival marker is BUTTON, so POL-NS-12 does not apply (it covers only GPS_AUTO): the arrival and the dwell rest on EV-GPS-02760. That artifact is down-weighted to 0.85 on issue code GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW - a single 60-second sampling gap from 12:25:04 to 12:26:04, before the arrival and outside the waiting window, with coverage of 93.9 per cent. Under POL-NS-08(b) that gap is too short (60 s, against the 120 s threshold) and too early to be a policy-level impairment, so the trace is not impaired under POL-NS-08 and POL-NS-09(e) is not engaged. Under POL-GEN-02(2) the ruling rests on that artifact and confidence is capped at 0.85, above the 0.70 floor. The finding survives the discount: the gap touches none of the 49 in-radius fixes and does not shorten the dwell run. I do not treat the driver's chat message 'hi im at the pickup point' (EV-CHAT-02760, sent 12:28:49) or the driver's statement 'Waited past the free period at the pin' as independent carriers - both merely restate what the trace already says, so neither lifts the 0.85 cap. The rider's counter-arguments do not change the outcome. POL-NS-02's 25 m accuracy filter: no fix reports horizontal accuracy, and an accuracy-less fix is neither counted nor excluded by that filter, so the 49 derived qualifying fixes stand and arrival is established. POL-NS-03 is not engaged, because the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius rather than outside it. POL-NS-05 finds nothing to correct (offset 0.0, held position, speed 0.0 kph). POL-NS-06 finds no shortfall: 482 s against 180 s is a 302 s surplus. POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider: the chat log holds only the driver's message, so limb (a) fails, and independently the rider track places the rider 806-814 m from the pin with rider_qualifying_fix_count = 0, far outside the 100 m STANDARD presence radius. The fee therefore stands as it presently is (POL-GEN-03: NO_ACTION on the fee). EV-FARE-02760 shows cancellation_fee 4.50, matching platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd 4.50, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 per cent of the SGD 4.50 fee - SGD 3.60 - the residual 20 per cent retained as the platform service fee; the anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d = 1, below the required 4, so the absolute-count limb fails on its own). Because compensation is paid, POL-GEN-03 makes the emitted ruling DRIVER_COMPENSATION, with amount_sgd mirroring driver_compensation_sgd at SGD 3.60. The monetary effect is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so it executes automatically. No clause of this policy produces a referral on these facts. This ruling is provisional and either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04.
Draft 4 - parties' positions swapped
To the rider: the $4.50 no-show cancellation fee stands and is not refunded. The driver arrived and waited as POL-NS-01 requires. EV-TRIP-02760 shows the 'I'm Here' tap at 12:28:24, the free-wait timer starting at 12:28:26, and the driver cancelling at 12:36:26 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW - one of the three codes limb (d) recognises. EV-GPS-02760 places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius (49 qualifying in-radius fixes, so the three-consecutive-fix test of POL-NS-02 is comfortably met) from 12:28:24, and shows him holding position there continuously for 482 seconds, against the 180-second free waiting period carried in trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec. Under POL-NS-01(c) that clock runs from the first in-geofence GPS fix, not from the tap (derived dwell_start_offset_sec = 0.0 s), and it exceeds the minimum by 302 seconds. Your arguments do not open an escape. (1) You say the arrival test cannot be confirmed because the trace reports no horizontal accuracy and the 49 qualifying fixes are a code assertion whose filter inputs are not before the judge. The qualifying-fix geometry is computed for this case and given in the brief; I do not recompute it, and the arrival test is met. (2) POL-NS-04 does not exonerate you: limb (a) fails, because the only chat message in EV-CHAT-02760 is the driver's ('hi im at the pickup point', 12:28:49), not a rider locating or coordinating message. (3) POL-NS-05 finds no false marker: the dwell begins within 0.0 s of the arrival tap and the in-geofence fixes record 0 km/h, far below the 15 km/h and 300 m triggers. (4) POL-NS-06 finds no shortfall: 482 s against 180 s is a surplus, not a deficit. (5) POL-NS-03 does not engage, because the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, not outside it. Your own device track, at 806-814 m from the pin with 0 qualifying fixes inside the 100 m presence radius, is consistent with the no-show; I note it only for that. What remains of your case is the weight of the trace. EV-GPS-02760 is flagged IMPAIRED by the pre-pass at weight_multiplier 0.85, issue code GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW - a single 60.0 s sampling gap from 12:25:04 to 12:26:04, coverage 93.9%. Under POL-NS-08 that gap is shorter than the 120 s threshold and lies before the waiting window, so it does not impair the trace for policy purposes, does not engage POL-NS-09, and does not cap the outcome at PARTIAL_REFUND. The arrival and the dwell are decided on the trace, at the discounted weight. To the driver: you are entitled to compensation of SGD 3.60, being 80% of the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee in force (trip_record.platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd; EV-FARE-02760 derived money.driver_compensation = 3.60), the residual 20% being retained as the platform service fee. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check on EV-DPROF-02760 does not trip: no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the 4 the first limb requires, so compensation is paid rather than withheld. Your account that you waited past the free period at the pin sits in the counterparty statement and supports the same finding; it carries no weight_multiplier and so enters neither the minimum nor the maximum of the confidence arithmetic. Confidence: the deciding fact - in-geofence arrival and the length of the dwell - is carried by EV-GPS-02760 at weight 0.85. Neither the trip record's arrival and wait-timer events (a driver-pressed BUTTON marker, which POL-NS-12 expressly does not treat as an independent platform measurement) nor the driver's single chat message supplies that fact independently, so POL-GEN-02(2) caps confidence at 0.85, and not at the bundle mean. The finding survives the 15% discount because the discount arises from a short gap outside the arrival and dwell window that touches neither the arrival nor the measured run. EV-TRIP-02760, EV-FARE-02760, EV-RPROF-02760 and EV-DPROF-02760 all sit at weight 1.0. Amount and routing: on a DRIVER_COMPENSATION ruling the two money fields carry the same figure, so amount_sgd = driver_compensation_sgd = SGD 3.60 (POL-GEN-03). The rider's $4.50 fee itself stands, which is the NO_ACTION disposition of the fee that POL-NS-07 describes. The monetary effect, SGD 3.60, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold in POL-GEN-05, so the ruling executes automatically. No clause produces a referral on these facts.
